Colovian Highlands, Silorn Ogres are large, dim-witted humanoids found throughout Tamriel, both above ground and below. Ogres in Wrothgar are sometimes called Snow Ogres and are differentiated from the common ogre by their thick coat of white fur. Some of these ogres can even use powerful frost magic. Diseased ogres can be found in Orcrest and near Baan Dar's Litter at the Anequina Aqueduct.
